title: Will I get banned for not using inclusive language in Issues, PRs or community support ?
body:
### Tested versions

All platforms

### System information

All Platforms

### Issue description

So as inclusive includes everyone except religious people speaking especially for my Muslim and Christian brothers, will we get banned ?

How does Godot refers the term "inclusivity" ? Or should I say how it is identified as ? Sorry but I am bad at speaking "inclusive" language. Just need some clarification as I would need to ask questions when I have doubt.. or when implementing a feature where I need some help. Is it important for me to speak the language that was introduced in recent years ? If yes then I would prefer to abstain as I am not willing to learn this language which has million pronouns. Almost all languages that I have learned usually have 1-5 pronouns, or at most 10 like some languages have different pronouns for singular/ plural stuff and for respect etc.. but I think it will get complicated if singular started identifying as a plural.. Its hard for me to comprehend with my sane mind how that works. So I won't be learning the language that is required for PRs, issues or community support. I would rather use a fork like Redot as I can speak my language and get the support I need. Also an additional question I have is that, do I need to dye my hair blue and become overweight ? Just asking for someone who reads this because I can't do both its haram.

Just wanted to confirm.
Thanks !

### Steps to reproduce

- Not knowing the inclusive language 
- getting banned
- No community support

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

All projects.
